decisions.decision: App-level WindowService for DragToResizeArea fullscreen awareness
decisions.rationale: WindowService wraps same windowManager singleton; both instances receive WindowListener callbacks
window_manager default 8, user reported 11 too large

decisions.decision: FFI-based true fullscreen bypassing window_manager's setFullScreen
decisions.rationale: window_manager only removes WS_THICKFRAME|WS_MAXIMIZEBOX, keeps WS_CAPTION — results in maximize not fullscreen. Manual FFI removes WS_CAPTION too.
BoxFit.contain shows black bars for aspect ratio mismatches (e.g. 4096x2160 on 16:9 window). BoxFit.cover fills window by cropping.
